    signalme as away
    signalme as happy
    signalme as ready
    signalme off
    signalme status

OPTIONS:

COMMANDS:
    as <status-or-signal>    Set a durable status, or play a temporary light    
                             signal

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Set a durable status, or play a temporary light signal

USAGE:
    signalme as <status-or-signal> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    signalme as available
    signalme as busy
    signalme as dnd
    signalme as away
    signalme as happy
    signalme as ready

ARGUMENTS:
    <status-or-signal>    Durable status:    available (or free), busy, away,   
                          do-not-disturb (or dnd)                               
                          Temporary signal:  happy, bored, desperate, ready,    
                          warning, alerting                                     
                                                                                
                          A temporary signal plays an animation and then        
                          restores the durable status,                          
                          except 'ready', which announces availability and ends 
                          on 'available'                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information
